functions.name: Forward Collision Detection
functions.description: Detect vehicles ahead and compute collision risk

functions.name: Autonomous Emergency Brake
functions.description: Apply brake autonomously if collision imminent

scenery.description: Paved highway, urban streets, suburban roads
Visible lane markings, well-maintained road surface

environment.description: Daylight, dusk, dawn; not night operation
Dry, wet road; not heavy rain, snow, or fog

driver_state.description: Driver monitoring; handoff expected within 2 seconds

performance_limitations.description: Cannot reliably detect stationary vehicles beyond 100m in standard light
performance_limitations.impact_summary: Collision detection latency increases with distance; closing-speed misestimation possible

performance_limitations.description: Low contrast (dawn/dusk) reduces confidence; high glare saturates sensor
performance_limitations.impact_summary: Function disabled during extreme lighting conditions per design

performance_limitations.description: Brake response time 200ms from command to pressure increase
performance_limitations.impact_summary: At 100 km/h, 200ms corresponds to 5.5m stopping distance; deceleration ramp-up non-instantaneous

functional_insufficiencies.description: Camera unable to detect motorcycles in lateral fields due to small profile
functional_insufficiencies.root_cause: Training data underrepresented motorcycles; algorithm confidence threshold too high

functional_insufficiencies.description: Object tracking fails when target temporarily occluded (bridge pillars, construction cones)
functional_insufficiencies.root_cause: Single-frame CNN; no temporal filtering; track reset on occlusion

functional_insufficiencies.description: Brake pressure demand conflicts with driver brake pedal input (unresolved in hybrid scenarios)
functional_insufficiencies.root_cause: Brake blending logic not validated for high-g collision avoidance + driver override

environmental.description: Sun glare (low sun angle, camera sensor saturation)

sensor.likelihood: < 10% of operating time in wet climates

road_user.description: Motorcycle approaching from adjacent lane (high speed, small profile)
Pedestrian in non-standard pose (lying on road, unusual clothing)

system_state.description: Sensor warm-up phase (first 10 seconds after startup)

combined.description: Heavy rain + dawn + motorcycle in adjacent lane

hazardous_behaviors.hazard_description: Motorcycle not detected; AEB not triggered; rear-end collision if motorcycle decelerates
Unintended brake surge due to driver pedal conflict; whiplash or secondary collision risk

scenarios.evidence: Motorcycle profiles underrepresented in training dataset; field reports confirm misdetections
HIL testing shows pressure conflict in high-g scenarios; user complaints in field data

acceptance_criteria.criterion_description: Probability of undetected collision threat (motorcycle scenario) shall be less than 1e-7 per operating hour
acceptance_criteria.rationale: SOTIF concept phase target; validation via fleet data and scenario testing

acceptance_criteria.criterion_description: Probability of unintended brake activation (due to system conflict) shall be less than 5e-8 per operating hour
acceptance_criteria.rationale: Residual risk target for brake pressure blending; justified by simulation + field testing
